summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (MAC Besim History of Bsorino/60)

data.turoyo: <...> Ŭ maḥatte harke, šməṭṭe i+badlayḏe, pliġalle baynә‿ḥḏoḏe.
data.translation: <...> And they put him here, took his suit off, and divided them among themselves.

rationale: Fills thin Preterit with possible feminine object suffix and reciprocal distribution of clothing; retains the edition's plural them.

summary: Both occurrences fit teilen. In the new passage the clothing theme is recoverable from i+badlayḏe, with possible feminine object -a, and baynә‿ḥḏoḏe marks the group among whom it is divided.

Read-only glossary_lookup entry flġ confirms fləġle/foləġ I 'teilen' and mfalaġle/mfaləġ II. The plġ p-spelling is retained; no unsupported root merger, form normalization or transfer of II evidence is made.
The ordinary reciprocal distribution complement is not sufficient to establish a separate light-verb idiom.
Confirm the -a/object and plural-agent segmentation of pliġalle.
